design.interp: h(alpha) = (1-alpha) h19(4,phi) + alpha h19(5,phi), full (1,16,1280) tensor, spliced through block 20
design.interp_in_pca: only the 3 interior alphas; alpha = 0/1 ARE the {4}/{5} states already in the tone classes
design.const: all ones; after revin the normalised input is exactly 0, so h19 = f(0), the zero-input state
design.amp_convention: A_TONE = sqrt 2 (unit power); mixtures use a = sqrt(0.5) per component
design.splice: block20_program.splice_block20 (hook on stacked_xf[18] replaces the block-19 output; the head is pointwise so block 20 alone acts)
design.arrow: F(h) - h with F from the model's own forward for the real states (splice identity guard) and from a splice for the interpolated ones; arrows drawn in the PCA plane

pca.centering: uncentred (SVD of the raw state matrix); the carrier is a common component, so centring would remove it
pca.plane_basis: orthonormal PC1/PC2 of the uncentred block-19 state matrix (sign of PC1 fixed to align with n_hat); the block-20 images are projected on the SAME basis

basis.point: h(a,b) = a*u + b*v, spliced through block 20

P1.statement: white noise sits OFF the degenerate manifold (low carrier-cos at block 19) and its block-20 image lands near the constant/DC output direction
P1.clause_dc_output_rule: every noise draw: ser_std < 0.05 (the post-revin 128-step forecast is flat to <5% of the unit input amplitude) and |cos(raw head channel, ones)| > 0.5

P2.statement: the constant series' state f(0) has a small norm; its block-20 response is near-identity and its output direction is the DC direction
P2.dc_output_caveat: sigma = 0 for this input (constant series), so the post-revin forecast is mu = 1 whatever the raw head output is; the DC-ness of the forecast is forced by the revin, not evidence about the model.  The raw head channel has norm 0.0237 -- the model's actual response to f(0) is ~0.

P3.statement: the 2D map shows the graded basin -- long flow arrows near the working tones, short near the nulls/mixtures, the carrier as the dominant axis, the mixtures in the null plateau
P3.clause_short_arrows_carrier_rule: min |dcos| over the working tones > max |dcos| over the nulls AND over the mixtures
P3.clause_short_arrows_displacement_rule: min ||F(h)-h|| over the working tones > max over the nulls
